title: ask_for directive payload
description: The DataPart 'data' object of an ask_for handoff directive. Delivered on a TaskStatusUpdateEvent that sets state to INPUT_REQUIRED (spec §7, §7.1). The Live layer collects the requested information and resumes the task by sending a ROLE_USER message with the structured data on the same contextId and taskId.

fields.description: The fields to collect from the caller.

validators.description: Validation rules the Live layer should apply before resuming.

cancellation.description: Cancellation behavior for the collection dialogue.

responseSchema.description: JSON Schema describing the structured data the Live layer must return on resume.
